# Catalog-backed composition corpus

The test builds a rooted successor of the existing dispatch reference corpus.
The first source says `A Depot` and the manifest renames it to catalog identity
`WH-A`. Each source has its own population, document and digest-bound anchors.
The root adds a catalog-dependent subset check and a proof target joining a
candidate shipment with the catalog product.

`expected.json` records observable outcomes. The two frozen reference-free
digests were captured at the LX2 completion commit. The LI2 case retains its
original asserted candidate identities and proposed resolution and adds a
separate reference relation.
